title: 好莱坞高管谈AI：创作与就业的平衡
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Bloomberg has devoted an entire team to covering the AI industry.
segments.zh: 彭博社组建了专门团队报道人工智能行业。

segments.en: The rise of artificial intelligence has divided Hollywood.
segments.zh: 人工智能的崛起让好莱坞产生分歧。

segments.en: The industry is torn between its desire to embrace new technology and its fear of what it could mean for their jobs, for compensation, and for creativity itself.
segments.zh: 行业内部矛盾重重：既想拥抱新技术，又担心它对工作、薪酬和创造力本身的影响。

segments.en: There are many in Hollywood who think that all these tech companies are out to steal their businesses and then there's some in the tech industry who feel that Hollywood needs to get its head out of the sand and embrace the future.
segments.zh: 好莱坞许多人认为科技公司想抢走他们的业务，而科技界一些人则认为好莱坞需要摆脱鸵鸟心态，拥抱未来。

segments.en: But we're building cognitive systems that have their own autonomy.
segments.zh: 但我们正在构建具有自主性的认知系统。

segments.en: Some people in Hollywood believe that you will take away the jobs from actual humans.
segments.zh: 好莱坞一些人认为这会夺走人类的工作。

segments.en: I see myself more as a new kind of paintbrush for filmmakers than a replacement for human autists.
segments.zh: 我认为自己更像是电影制作人的新型画笔，而不是人类自闭症患者的替代品。

segments.en: How can Hollywood chart a responsible path forward amid rapid technological change?
segments.zh: 好莱坞如何在快速技术变革中负责任地前行？

segments.en: Marge Dean, George Trumpless, Duncan Crabtree Ireland, and Kishori Rajan have come together to get beyond the headline.
segments.zh: Marge Dean、George Trumpless、Duncan Crabtree Ireland 和 Kishori Rajan 齐聚一堂，探讨超越头条的议题。

segments.en: Diding this conversation is our colleague Brad Stone. I'm Lucas Shaw, managing editor of Media Entertainment Sports at Bloomberg News.
segments.zh: 参与本次对话的是我们的同事布拉德·斯通。我是卢卡斯·肖，彭博新闻社媒体娱乐体育部的总编辑。

segments.en: Welcome to Business Week convened. Let's dive right in. Let's try to cut through the hype.
segments.zh: 欢迎来到《商业周刊》大会。我们直接开始吧。让我们试着拨开炒作迷雾。

segments.en: To Marge, you're at Skybound. You produce the incredibly addictive animated series, Invincible on Pride.
segments.zh: 玛吉，你在Skybound工作。你制作了令人上瘾的动画剧集《无敌少侠》在Prime上。

segments.en: So you've been an animation for much of your career.
segments.zh: 所以你职业生涯的大部分时间都在做动画。
